title: Aid to RSSI-hit sugarcane workers to hit P1.9B by yearend, says DSWD
summary: BACOLOD CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development’s ongoing distribution of Emergency Cash Transfers (ECT) to small sugarcane farmers and workers whose crops have been destroyed…

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development’s ongoing distribution of Emergency Cash Transfers (ECT) to small sugarcane farmers and workers whose crops have been destroyed by red-striped soft scale insects (RSSI) in Negros Island will hit P1.9 billion before the end of this year, Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian said on Tuesday, Sept. 22. The distribution will cover about 190,000 beneficiaries in Negros Occidental and Negros Oriental who will receive a little over P10,000 each, said Gatchalian, who joined the 2026 “Bayani Ka! Cum Tatak KALAHI-CIDSS LGU Awards and Performance-Based Grant for Sustainability” at SM Sky Hall here. […]... Keep on reading: Aid to RSSI-hit sugarcane workers to hit P1.9B by yearend, says DSWD
